hooks.command: for port in 5005 5006 3001; do for pid in $(lsof -ti tcp:$port -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null); do case "$(lsof -a -p "$pid" -d cwd -Fn 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^n//p' | head -1)" in *proksion-portfolio*) kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null;; esac; done; done; for pid in $(pgrep -f 'bun run --watch src/index.ts' 2>/dev/null); do case "$(lsof -a -p "$pid" -d cwd -Fn 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^n//p' | head -1)" in *proksion-portfolio*) kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null;; esac; done
